entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 482 aa; predicted molecular weight 48.6 kDa and pI 6.22.
Contains YjeF_N domain at residues 25–184 and Carb_kinase-like domain at residues 241–456.
Shares 53–57% identity and 90–98% coverage with reviewed Mycobacterium Nnr homologs.
Best-supported annotation is bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme with epimerase and ADP-dependent dehydratase activities.
Predicted to bind one K+ ion per subunit based on close reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Corresponds to EC 5.1.99.6; Rhea references include RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Uses ADP to dehydrate (6S)-NADHX or (6S)-NADPHX, producing AMP, phosphate, and the repaired NADH or NADPH.
Corresponds to EC 4.2.1.136; Rhea references include RHEA:32223 and RHEA:32235.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: Repairs hydrated NAD(P)H species generated by enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration, preserving functional NADH/NADPH pools.
Associated GO processes include metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
